purpose: Routing: fire on reference-port planning and post-implementation port/spec review; stay quiet on ordinary bugfixes, docs, GUI tweaks, and releases.

cases.prompt: Let's plan porting DungeonAlerts from References into a new KE module. I want the approach verified before we write the plan.
cases.assert: Mode plan debate runs before the implementation plan is frozen.

cases.prompt: We just brainstormed three approaches for adapting the NorskenUI castbar module. Which one should we commit to?
cases.assert: Approach choice is debated by both models with References/ evidence, not decided single-model.

cases.prompt: This new module touches nameplates and aura durations in 12.0 — verify the plan handles secret values before we implement.
cases.assert: WoW API risk claims are cross-verified against .wow-api-reference with file citations.

cases.prompt: Implementation of the frozen plan is done. Review the diff against the plan and the reference addon before merge.
cases.assert: Mode diff debate reviews spec fidelity and port fidelity on the same base/head SHAs.

cases.prompt: I think our port drifted from the reference implementation - can you cross-check what atrocityEssentials actually does here?
cases.assert: Claims about the reference are grounded in References/atrocityEssentials file:line evidence.

cases.prompt: BugSack shows a nil index error in DamageMeter/Core.lua line 412, fix it.
cases.assert: Ordinary debugging follows the debug-first workflow, no multi-model debate.

cases.prompt: Update the changelog and README for the v3.4.1 release.
cases.assert: Docs and release chores never invoke the debate.

cases.prompt: Add a width slider to the HealerMana GUI page.
cases.assert: Routine GUI work uses gui-module-page conventions only.

cases.prompt: Run luacheck across the repo and clean up warnings.
cases.assert: Lint sweeps are mechanical; no debate.

cases.prompt: Commit these changes and tag the release.
cases.assert: Git operations never invoke the debate.
